mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is always active in the current low-rate environment.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% for 12 months and 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 7.0%, labor market weakness signals economic uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7.0% for 3 consecutive months and 20d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL is below 235, the low-inflation, low-rate environment supports equity valuations, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: low inflation and low rate environment
failure_condition: In periods meeting FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 235, 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of high retail sales (RSAFS > 400,000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 7.5%), robust consumer demand and labor market stability drive positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: high retail sales and low unemployment regime
failure_condition: In periods meeting RSAFS > 400000 AND UNRATE < 7.5%, 20d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100, manufacturing sector expansion signals strong economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 for 3 consecutive months and 5d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100 and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900, combined manufacturing and housing expansion signals robust economic growth, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In periods meeting INDPRO > 100 AND HOUST > 900, 60d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth rate (annualized) exceeds 2.0%, the economy is in a strong expansion phase, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and 60d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
